scope: User-facing application fixes only; preserve the live PostgreSQL deployment.
included: Chat follows streamed replies and completed results, preserves history scrolling and offers Jump to latest.
Composer shrinks after sending; stalled streams show progress notices and stop after loss of contact without replaying commands.
Persisted sound decisions include recording identity; song-scoped full-mix reviews remain in context.
Unverified actions stop dependent commands within the current tool batch.
Legacy Stripe customer replacement uses a null-safe query supported by SQLite and PostgreSQL.
CI runs pytest fixtures on SQLite and isolated PostgreSQL; deployment preserves installers, model assets and existing secret references.
Release metadata records the deployed application commit and task while preserving Bridge version identity.
excluded: Marketing tracks, recorded videos, captions and media assets.
Marketing capture scripts, replay/restore tools and scripted sound approvals.
Automatic Ableton screen-following and updated audition capture require a separately tested, signed Bridge/OSC extension release; the published 1.3.6 installer is unchanged.
Unrelated modifications in other working directories.
deployment_gate: Backend suites for both databases, frontend tests, production build and desktop/mobile browser verification must pass.
